notes: Claim numbering: c01 summary, c02-c06 keyPoints, c07-c56 body in order. Per-claim evidence is summarised; unsupported items were mostly communication/sleep/home-adaptation tips, delirium trust-page sentences, Alzheimer's Society support line, Law Society/solicitor, carer GP registration. Sudden confusion route: retrieved text says call 999 or go to A&E (NHS 111 Wales page); 'rather than driving' was not found and was removed. Samaritans and NHS 111 mental health option cited to NHS Every Mind Matters and Kent and Medway NHS Trust page (no samaritans.org page returned). Communication tips attributed to dementia charities/NHS trusts because the search blended pages. Phone numbers beyond 116 123 (Dementia UK helpline, Breathing Space) come from retrieved Dementia UK and NHS Borders pages. Lead author removed two helpline phone numbers (Dementia UK, Breathing Space) taken from local pages whose numbers conflicted elsewhere; Samaritans 116 123 kept.
